ctx.x: Harry Richman. Cliff Friend, who wrote "Just A Baby's Prayer At Twilight" was a singer there, and they used to have all of the clientele, 'course, was all of the movie stars-- Blanche Sweet, Charlie Chaplin, Fatty Arbuckle and all of the oldtimers, you know, was there every night 'cause they'd never heard a band like ours.
I think you mentioned Mary Pickford, didn't you?
